questions.question: Every form of Ichigo Kurosaki
questions.subject: Ichigo Kurosaki
questions.note: One of the original seventeen. Ichigo is the open trade in this bank: the kind-fold threshold that removed roughly eighty junk members across Goku, Vegeta, Sukuna and Ichigo also cost him three canon items, 6/11 to 5/11 here. His off-kind ratio is 0.81 to 1.29, so the fold is off for him. A variant letting the wiki's page type override the model's guess was measured and rejected -- it rescues one item on Goku and admits six junk ones on Sukuna, and Ichigo's three have no page typed as the asked kind, so nothing in the data recovers them. Bank audit 2026-08-14: added 1 item(s) the wiki documents and the bank omitted: Merged Hollow Form. Each verified against the cited page's raw wikitext.

questions.question: Every current Espada (the ten active Espada of Aizen's Arrancar army)
questions.subject: Espada
questions.note: Current-versus-former probe. The Espada page's notable-members table holds 13 rows for 12 individuals because Yammy appears as both Diez (10th, pre-release) and Cero (0, post-release), and the 3rd and 6th seats each carry a former holder: Nelliel (former Tres) and Luppi (temporary Sexta, killed by Grimmjow to reclaim the seat). The current ten are the seat holders during the Arrancar arc. absent excludes the former holders and the Privaron Espada.

questions.question: Every current captain of the Gotei 13 (each of the 13 Division captains as of the end of the Thousand-Year Blood War)
questions.subject: Gotei 13
questions.note: Named point in time: the wiki's Gotei 13 page lists each division's current captain with no era label, and that roster is the post-Thousand-Year Blood War one (Kyoraku as Captain-Commander; Isane, Iba, Lisa, Rukia and the others appointed after Yamamoto's death and the war). absent excludes the former captains the same page lists under Former Members.

questions.question: Every Visored
questions.subject: Visored
questions.note: A short complete set, taken from the Visored article's own `notable members` field rather than from prose. Eight were Hollowfied by Aizen's experiment a century before the main story; Ichigo Kurosaki gained his mask separately and the wiki lists him among them regardless, so he is counted here. Both spellings of Rojuro Otoribashi's given name appear in the wild, hence the aliases.

questions.question: Every member of the Visored
questions.subject: Visored
questions.note: The wiki lists eight known Visored and counts Ichigo Kurosaki as an unofficial ninth -- the infobox adds him, but the page states there are eight known Visored aside from Ichigo -- so Ichigo sits in absent.

questions.question: What is the name of Ichigo Kurosaki's Zanpakutō spirit?
questions.subject: Ichigo Kurosaki
questions.note: The page names Zangetsu as Ichigo's Zanpakutō spirit and Tensa Zangetsu as the Bankai spirit, then reveals the true nature is two blades: the inner Hollow and the old man (his Quincy powers). Tensa Zangetsu is an alias so either name scores.

questions.question: Who killed Masaki Kurosaki, Ichigo's mother?
questions.subject: Masaki Kurosaki
questions.note: The page attributes her death to the Hollow Grand Fisher, whose lure she went to protect Ichigo from; it adds that she died because Yhwach's Auswahlen had stolen her Quincy powers, leaving her unable to defend herself. Cross-entity relation.

questions.question: Who killed the Soul King?
questions.subject: Soul King
questions.note: The wiki states Yhwach stabbed the Soul King through the chest and later destroyed the crystal and completely absorbed him. Ichigo was forced by Yhwach's Blut Vene to bisect the already-stabbed Soul King, but the page does not credit Ichigo with the kill. Cross-entity relation.

questions.question: Who is the current Captain-Commander of the Gotei 13?
questions.subject: Gotei 13
questions.note: The Gotei 13 page names Genryusai Shigekuni Yamamoto as the former and inaugural Captain-Commander (1000 years in post) and Shunsui Kyoraku as the current one.

questions.question: Every ability of Ichigo Kurosaki
questions.subject: Ichigo Kurosaki
questions.note: Scope core because the Ichigo page's Powers & Abilities lists his combat skill, spiritual power traits and named techniques together, and completeness needs all three. Curated to nineteen current named abilities: the former powers -- Hollow Mask, Vasto Lorde, Fullbring and Final Getsuga Tensho -- are deliberately excluded because bleach-set-01 (forms) and bleach-set-02 (techniques) already measure them and the page lists them as superseded states, not present abilities.

questions.question: Every ability of Rukia Kuchiki
questions.subject: Rukia Kuchiki
questions.note: Scope closed because the Rukia page's Powers & Abilities section lists exactly these seventeen named abilities: her combat and energy traits plus Sode no Shirayuki's Shikai and its named dance techniques through Hakka no Togame. First question in the bank scoped to Rukia.

questions.question: Every ability of Byakuya Kuchiki
questions.subject: Byakuya Kuchiki
questions.note: Scope closed because the Byakuya page's Powers & Abilities section lists exactly these seventeen named abilities: his combat and energy traits plus Senbonzakura's techniques through Shūkei: Hakuteiken. Distinct from bleach-set-03, which asks for his techniques only (6 items) and omits his physical and energy traits. The page spells the Bankai area move Gōkei where bleach-set-03 spells it Gokei, so the macronless form is kept as an alias. Prefix pair Senbonzakura / Senbonzakura Kageyoshi is deliberate: the wiki documents both as named abilities.

aliases: way of onmitsu 3rd of the shiho
vibrant display of a thousand cherry blossoms

questions.question: Every ability of Kenpachi Zaraki
questions.subject: Kenpachi Zaraki
questions.note: Scope closed because the Zaraki page's Powers & Abilities section lists exactly these seventeen named abilities: his combat traits, Kendō and Ryōdan, Nozarashi with its Shikai and Bankai, and his spiritual power traits. First question in the bank scoped to Kenpachi.

questions.question: Every ability of Sōsuke Aizen
questions.subject: Sousuke Aizen
questions.note: Scope closed because the Aizen page's Powers & Abilities section lists exactly these twenty named abilities: his intellect, combat and energy traits, Hōgyoku Fusion and Immortality, and Kyōka Suigetsu's Shikai and Kanzen Saimin. The page records Bankai as unrevealed, so none is listed. Former Powers -- the Hōgyoku-evolved fused forms -- are excluded as forms rather than abilities. Subject is the canonical page title Sousuke Aizen; the accented Sōsuke Aizen page is a redirect to it, and the bank already uses the ASCII spelling.
